AccountId.title: Guid update value
AccountId.description: Unique identifier of the account (for example `Customer`) the item is assigned to (or `null` if the assigned account should not be updated). If defined, valid account identifier must be provided.

BillId.title: Guid update value
BillId.description: Unique identifier of the `Bill` the items is assigned to. It's possible to assign item to bill belonging to another account, in that case both `AccountId` and `BillId` must be provided.
